svg.title: A real JuTell report, condensed for this page
svg.desc: Condensed from an actual JuTell run: changed the login button text, kept the login logic. Confirmed by re-reading the file and running the existing tests, both passing, with low risk and one thing left for the user to check.

g.text: A real result, not a mockup
Condensed from a real JuTell run — request: "Change the login button text to
'Get Started'. Keep the function the same."
Login button text only, in one file. Button id and click handler are unchanged.
Re-read the edited file directly. Ran the existing test suite — 2/2 tests passed.
Only the button text changed. Login handling was not touched.
Click the button once to confirm login still works.
See the full raw report → docs/releases/2.0.0-showcase.md
